AMENDMENT TO PARAGRAPH 6(i) OF MINUTE ON THE AUDIT EXAMINERS’ SERVICE

THE paragraph 6(i) of Minute on the Audit Examiners’ Service published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 380/61 of20th December 1985 has been amended by the Public Service Commission and the amended paragraphs are published forinformation.
This amendment will be effective from 11th September 2007.
H. M. GAMINI SENEVIRATHNE,The Secretary,Public Service Commission.
At the Office of the Public Service Commission,No. 177, Nawala Road,Narahenpita,Colombo 05,on 03rd November 2016.
Amendment to Paragraph 6(i) of Minute on the Audit Examiners’ Service

The paragraph 6(i) of Minute on the Audit Examiners’ Service published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 380/61 of 20thDecember 1985 has been amended by the Public Service Commission and the amended paragraphs are published forinformation.

6(i) In case of a request made to the Appointing Authority according to the specimen form by the Officers ofAudit Examiners’ Service - Grade II who has fulfilled the following qualifications, will be promoted to the Grade I afterscrutinizing the qualifications by the Appointing Authority.

I. Should have been confirmed in the appointment ;
II. Should have completed at least ten (10) years of active and satisfactory service in Grade II of the categoryof service and earned ten (10) salary increments.

III. Should have shown a performance of satisfactory or higher level of performance during the period of ten(10) years prior to the date of promotion as per the approved procedure of performance appraisal
IV. Should have completed five (05) years of satisfactory service immediately before the date of promotion.
V. Should have obtained the prescribed level of proficiency in the other official language.
VI. Should have passed the prescribed Efficiency Bar Examination on the due date.
